title: Increase BlueFire logo size across all locations

requirements.text: In the Header component (frontend/src/components/Header.tsx), increase the BlueFire logo size from 40px to 64px by updating the img element's width and height attributes

quotes: hazlo mas grande en todas las ubicaciones

acceptanceCriteria: Logo in header navigation displays at 64px width and height
Logo maintains aspect ratio and visual quality at larger size
Logo remains properly aligned with the company name text

requirements.text: In the HeroSection component (frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx), increase the BlueFire logo size from 48px to 80px by updating the img element's width and height attributes in the badge section

quotes: hazlo mas grande en todas las ubicaciones

acceptanceCriteria: Logo in hero section displays at 80px width and height
Logo remains properly positioned within the badge container
Logo maintains visual hierarchy with the company name and tagline

requirements.text: In the Footer component (frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx), increase the BlueFire logo size from 32px to 56px by updating the img element's width and height attributes

quotes: hazlo mas grande en todas las ubicaciones

acceptanceCriteria: Logo in footer displays at 56px width and height
Logo maintains proper alignment with surrounding footer content
Footer layout remains balanced with the larger logo size

constraints: Do not change the logo image file itself, only adjust the display dimensions
Maintain the existing logo positioning and alignment patterns in each component
Preserve all other styling and layout properties in the affected components
nonGoals: Modifying the logo design or colors
Changing the logo file path or source location
Altering any other component styling beyond logo dimensions
